headline: Security tightened: BGB deployed in five districts for AL anniversary
summary: The government has deployed Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) and the Army to prevent illegal gatherings and maintain law and order ahead of the Awami League's anniversary.
details: The government has deployed Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) in five districts to tighten security ahead of the Awami League's anniversary on June 23. The BGB will be active in Cox's Bazar, Madaripur, Sherpur, Gazipur, and Moulvibazar from Monday evening until June 30.
caption:
BGB and Army deployed across multiple districts to prevent illegal gatherings ahead of the Awami League's anniversary.

The government has deployed Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) in five districts to tighten security ahead of the Awami League's anniversary on June 23. The BGB will be active in Cox's Bazar, Madaripur, Sherpur, Gazipur, and Moulvibazar from Monday evening until June 30.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com, Somoy News

headline_marked: Uber [[launches Premier Plus ride category]] in Dhaka
headline: Uber launches Premier Plus ride category in Dhaka
summary: The new service offers access to newer sedan vehicles and highly rated drivers for passengers seeking a premium travel experience.
details: Uber has introduced a new ride category called Premier Plus in Dhaka. The service is aimed at passengers who prioritize comfort, quality, and reliability when traveling across the city.
The new category provides access to newer sedan vehicles and drivers who have been recognized for maintaining high service ratings.
Users can access the service through the Uber app by entering their destination and selecting Premier Plus from the available ride options before confirming their booking.
caption:
Looking for a more premium ride in Dhaka? Uber just launched Premier Plus.

Uber has introduced a new ride category called Premier Plus in Dhaka. The service is aimed at passengers who prioritize comfort, quality, and reliability when traveling across the city.

The new category provides access to newer sedan vehicles and drivers who have been recognized for maintaining high service ratings.

Users can access the service through the Uber app by entering their destination and selecting Premier Plus from the available ride options before confirming their booking.
